# MetaEntityIcon

<!-- description:start -->
A dispatcher component that renders the correct icon for any Tracker meta entity type — project, portfolio, goal, or key result. Pass the entity object and the component automatically selects and renders the appropriate icon with a deterministic color derived from the entity ID.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {MetaEntityIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<MetaEntityIcon entity={{entityType: 'project', id: 'proj-1', shortId: 42}} />
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * The meta entity to display an icon for.
     * Only `entityType`, `id`, and `shortId` are required.
     */
    entity: {
        entityType: 'project' | 'portfolio' | 'goal' | 'keyResult';
        /** String entity ID (used for portfolio color generation). */
        id: string;
        /** Numeric short ID (used for project and goal color generation). */
        shortId: number;
    };

    /**
     * Size of the SVG icon inside the container in pixels.
     * @default 20
     */
    size?: number;
}
```
<!-- props:end -->

---

## Supported entity types

| `entityType` | Rendered component | Color source |
|---|---|---|
| `'project'` | [`ProjectIcon`](../ProjectIcon/README.md) | `shortId` |
| `'portfolio'` | [`PortfolioIcon`](../PortfolioIcon/README.md) | `id` |
| `'goal'` | [`GoalIcon`](../GoalIcon/README.md) | `shortId` |
| `'keyResult'` | [`KeyResultIcon`](../KeyResultIcon/README.md) | fixed asset, no color |
| anything else | `null` (renders nothing) | — |

---

## Examples

### All entity types

```tsx
import {MetaEntityIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<MetaEntityIcon entity={{entityType: 'project',   id: 'proj-1',  shortId: 42}} />
<MetaEntityIcon entity={{entityType: 'portfolio', id: 'port-1',  shortId: 7}}  />
<MetaEntityIcon entity={{entityType: 'goal',      id: 'goal-1',  shortId: 99}} />
```

### Custom size

```tsx
// 32 px icon for a page header
<MetaEntityIcon
    entity={{entityType: 'project', id: 'proj-1', shortId: 42}}
    size={32}
/>
```

### Rendering from a Tracker API response

Requires the `"tracker:entities:write"` permission in your plugin's `manifest.json`:

```json
{
    "permissions": {
        "data": ["tracker:entities:write"]
    }
}
```

`MetaEntityIcon` accepts the shape returned directly by the Tracker entities search endpoint, so you can pass `result.data[i]` without any mapping:

```tsx
import React, {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
import {MetaEntityIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {MetaEntityV2} from '@weavix/tracker-api-types';

interface Props {
    trackerApi: TrackerApi;
}

export const EntityList: React.FC<Props> = ({trackerApi}) => {
    const [entities, setEntities] = useState<MetaEntityV2[]>([]);

    useEffect(() => {
        trackerApi.v3
            .post['/entities/{entityType}/_search']({
                pathParams: {entityType: 'project'},
                queryParams: {fields: ['summary'], page: 1, perPage: 20},
                bodyParams: {filter: {}, filterTypes: ['ALL'], input: ''},
            })
            .then((result) => setEntities(result.data));
    }, [trackerApi]);

    return (
        <ul>
            {entities.map((entity) => (
                <li key={entity.id} style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
                    <MetaEntityIcon entity={entity} size={20} />
                    <span>{entity.fields?.summary?.value ?? entity.id}</span>
                </li>
            ))}
        </ul>
    );
};
```

### Used inside MetaEntitiesSelect

`MetaEntityIcon` is used internally by [`MetaEntitiesSelect`](../../MetaEntitiesSelect/README.md) to render each item in the suggest list. You do not need to use it directly when using that component.

---

## Notes

- The `entity` prop only requires `entityType`, `id`, and `shortId` — it is compatible with the full `MetaEntityV2` type from `@weavix/tracker-api-types`.
- For unknown `entityType` values the component renders `null` silently.
- To render individual entity icons directly, use [`ProjectIcon`](../ProjectIcon/README.md), [`PortfolioIcon`](../PortfolioIcon/README.md), [`GoalIcon`](../GoalIcon/README.md), or [`KeyResultIcon`](../KeyResultIcon/README.md).
